headlines.title: G.T.I. Security | Penalties for RMT
headlines.summary: Dear Operators, The Delta Force security team is committed to maintaining a fair gaming experience, and will impose appropriate restrictions on those found to be cheating or in breach of our terms of service. Recently, our security team discovered that a large number of players have been maliciously manipulating the matchmaking mechanism to move supplies between game matches. These illegal RMT transactions primarily involved moving supplies through queue sniping, severely undermining the fairness of the in-game environment.
